apps.name: Bodywake

apps.name: Phosphor

apps.name: Blackout Kit

apps.name: Street Board
apps.desc: A noticeboard for your street that keeps working in an outage: needs, offers, road news and who's safe. Posts pass phone to phone by a link or over a mesh radio while the network is down, and sync up when it's back.

apps.name: Sealed Letters
apps.desc: Letters that open later: on a date, or if you stop checking in. Encrypted in your browser, with the key split among friends you choose, so no company and no single friend can open one early.
